es.summary: Conjunto de estrategias para optimizar el uso de antibióticos, reducir la resistencia y mejorar los resultados del paciente.
key_points: Uso basado en guías y resultados de cultivos
Preferir antibióticos de espectro estrecho cuando sea posible
Monitoreo continuo de efectos y respuesta clínica
Educación al paciente sobre adherencia y riesgos

mechanism: Implementar guías basadas en evidencia para selección de antibiótico
Obtener cultivos antes de iniciar terapia y ajustar según sensibilidad
Desescalar a antibiótico de espectro estrecho cuando sea viable
Limitar la duración al tiempo mínimo necesario para curar la infección
Revisar la terapia diariamente para detectar oportunidades de discontinuación
indications: Todo paciente que requiera terapia antibiótica
Pacientes hospitalizados con riesgo elevado de infección
contraindications: No existen contraindicaciones específicas al concepto; se aplica a todas las prescripciones antibióticas
nursing_care: Verificar orden médica y diagnóstico antes de administrar antibiótico
Obtener y enviar muestras para cultivo antes de iniciar la terapia
Monitorear signos de infección y posibles efectos adversos
Retener el antibiótico si falta indicación clara y notificar al profesional de salud
Documentar duración, cambios y respuesta al tratamiento
patient_teaching: Tomar el antibiótico exactamente como se indica, sin omitir dosis
Completar el curso completo aunque los síntomas mejoren
No compartir antibióticos con otras personas
Entender la importancia de no exigir antibióticos innecesarios

outcomes: Paciente sin signos de infección durante la hospitalización
Cultivos negativos al final de la terapia antibiótica

interventions.action: Revisar órdenes de antibióticos con el farmacéutico para asegurar indicación adecuada
interventions.rationale: Previene uso innecesario y reduce resistencia

interventions.action: Obtener cultivos antes de iniciar antibiótico y ajustar según resultados
interventions.rationale: Permite seleccionar el agente más efectivo y de espectro estrecho

interventions.action: Monitorear temperatura, frecuencia cardíaca y signos locales de infección cada 4 h
interventions.rationale: Detecta tempranamente deterioro o fracaso terapéutico

interventions.action: Educar al paciente sobre la importancia de completar el tratamiento y evitar automedicación
interventions.rationale: Mejora adherencia y disminuye riesgo de resistencia

interventions.action: Documentar duración prevista y cualquier cambio en la terapia en la historia clínica
interventions.rationale: Facilita la continuidad del cuidado y la evaluación de la efectividad

en.summary: Set of strategies to optimize antibiotic use, reduce resistance, and improve patient outcomes.
key_points: Use based on guidelines and culture results
Continuous monitoring of effects and clinical response
Patient education on adherence and risks

mechanism: Implement evidence-based guidelines for antibiotic selection
Obtain cultures before starting therapy and adjust based on sensitivity
De-escalate to narrow-spectrum antibiotic when feasible
Limit duration to the minimum necessary to cure the infection
Review therapy daily to identify opportunities for discontinuation
indications: Hospitalized patients at high risk of infection
contraindications: No specific contraindications to the concept; applies to all antibiotic prescriptions
nursing_care: Verify medical order and diagnosis before administering antibiotic
Obtain and send samples for culture before initiating therapy
Monitor signs of infection and potential adverse effects
Withhold antibiotic if no clear indication and notify health professional
Document duration, changes, and response to treatment
patient_teaching: Take the antibiotic exactly as prescribed, do not skip doses
Complete the full course even if symptoms improve
Do not share antibiotics with others
Understand the importance of not demanding unnecessary antibiotics

outcomes: Patient without signs of infection during hospitalization
Negative cultures at the end of antibiotic therapy

interventions.action: Review antibiotic orders with the pharmacist to ensure appropriate indication
interventions.rationale: Prevents unnecessary use and reduces resistance

interventions.action: Obtain cultures before starting antibiotic and adjust based on results
interventions.rationale: Allows selection of the most effective narrow-spectrum agent

interventions.action: Monitor temperature, heart rate, and local infection signs every 4 h
interventions.rationale: Detects early deterioration or therapeutic failure

interventions.action: Educate the patient on the importance of completing treatment and avoiding self-medication
interventions.rationale: Improves adherence and reduces resistance risk

interventions.action: Document planned duration and any changes in therapy in the medical record
interventions.rationale: Facilitates continuity of care and effectiveness evaluation

summary.0.quote: The term antibiotic stewardship refers to efforts to improve antibiotic prescribing strategies so infections are treated effectively without contributing to the development of antibiotic resistance.

key_points.0.quote: Use antibiotics with a broader spectrum of activity when appropriate, based on susceptibility testing.

key_points.1.quote: prescribing the correct route, dose, and duration of antibiotic treatment regiments

key_points.2.quote: tailoring antibiotic therapy to specific organisms as opposed to immediately implementing broad-spectrum antibiotics

key_points.4.quote: This may simply mean adhering to best practices for using antibiotics and providing patient education, or it may involve active participation on a committee that is attempting to implement the initiatives on a specific unit or within the institution.

sections.mechanism.0.quote: The CDC (2024) has developed a set of core elements that serve as guidelines for improving antibiotic use in practice.

sections.mechanism.2.quote: tailoring antibiotic therapy to specific organisms as opposed to immediately implementing broad-spectrum antibiotics

sections.indications.1.quote: Risk factors for infection with VRE include (Doganci et al., 2023): history of invasive surgical procedures or medical device placement long-term hospitalization previous use of vancomycin to treat an infection weak immune system (e.g., HIV, critically ill patients)

sections.nursing_care.2.quote: For this reason, antibiotics should be used with caution in this population, and patients prescribed antibiotics should be monitored closely for the duration of therapy

sections.patient_teaching.0.quote: It is also important for individuals who are prescribed a course of antibiotics not to miss a dose or stop taking the medication before they complete all doses—doing so only ensures that more bacteria survive to pass on resistance to new generations.

sections.patient_teaching.1.quote: For this reason, nurses must emphasize the importance of finishing the entire course of antibiotics, even if the patient reports improved symptoms, and not sharing medications with others.
